• products (147 items): productName, brandName, category, price, sellingPrice,
countInStock (quản lý tồn kho), sales (lượt đã bán), productImage[] (Cloudinary URLs)
• users (3 accounts): name, email, password (bcrypt), role (Admin/General),
• orders (Customer orders): productDetails[], email, name, userId, totalAmount,
paymentDetails (paymentId, status), status (Pending, Processing, Delivered, Cancelled, Refunded)
• reviews (8 reviews): userId, productId, review, rating
